messages.text: Plugins connect your tools and add new capabilities, helping me turn your research, ideas, and projects into finished work.

messages.text: Here are a few to get started:

messages.text: Data science—got it. I can turn raw datasets, notebooks, and business questions into cleaned analysis and clear charts.

It acknowledges the role and previews data-analysis tasks ChatGPT Work can help with before suggested plugins appear. ChatGPT Work is the product name. No placeholders or markup.

messages.text: Design—got it. I can help you move from idea to interface: critique a screen, explore directions, turn a reference into working UI, or polish an existing product.

It acknowledges the role and previews design tasks ChatGPT Work can help with before suggested plugins appear. ChatGPT Work is the product name. No placeholders or markup.

messages.text: Engineering—got it. I can map an unfamiliar codebase, plan and build features, trace bugs across logs and tests, and run checks to verify behavior.

It acknowledges the role and previews finance tasks ChatGPT Work can help with before suggested plugins appear. ChatGPT Work is the product name. No placeholders or markup.

messages.text: I can help you connect the tools you use, learn how you like to work, and set up skills for the things you do most. It only takes a few minutes, and you can change anything later.

Skills means reusable AI capabilities, not a person's abilities. No placeholders.

messages.text: To confirm: Does {role} still describe your current role best?
messages.description: Third complete paragraph streamed in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation when the end user has already selected a role during workspace onboarding. messages.text: To get started, which role best describes your work?
messages.description: Third complete paragraph streamed in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation when the end user has not saved a professional role. It appears immediately before a numbered role-selection card and asks a neutral question without assuming that the user works in design, engineering, product, or research. No placeholders or markup.

First complete paragraph streamed as the assistant's deterministic reply in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. It welcomes the end user to setting up the ChatGPT Work product. Keep the brand name ChatGPT Work unchanged. No placeholders.

Label on the first pill-shaped action below the suggested-plugin list in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Selecting it asks ChatGPT to create a scheduled daily briefing from connected apps and show the automation before enabling it. It appears above the sibling Learn my writing style action. Keep this imperative first-person request short enough for a compact pill. No placeholders or markup.

messages.text: Create a daily automation that prepares a concise briefing focused on my connected apps like email, calendar, and Slack. Show me the automation before enabling it.
messages.description: User-visible prompt submitted when an end user selects Send me a daily briefing in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. It asks ChatGPT to prepare a recurring daily briefing using connected tools such as email, calendar, and Slack, then show the proposed scheduled automation for approval before activating it. Slack is a product name and must remain unchanged. No markup or placeholders.

messages.text: Next, let’s personalize how Work helps you:
messages.description: Short heading below the suggested-plugin list in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. It introduces two pill-shaped actions for setting up a daily briefing or teaching ChatGPT the end user's writing style. Work refers to the ChatGPT Work product mode. Keep the sentence concise enough to fit on one line when space permits. No placeholders or markup.

Label on the second pill-shaped action below the suggested-plugin list in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Selecting it starts the writing-style task in chat, or opens the new writing-style setup modal when that experience is enabled. It appears below the sibling Send me a daily briefing action. Keep this imperative first-person request short enough for a compact pill. No placeholders or markup.

Short primary-button label in the bottom-right corner of the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Activating it confirms the selected job role and reveals the next deterministic assistant message. No placeholders.

Short heading on the rounded role-confirmation card displayed after the introductory assistant message finishes streaming in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. The card lets the end user choose a single role from numbered options, including Other. No placeholders.

Short heading on the job-role selection card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. It appears when the end user has not selected a specific job role in ChatGPT workspace onboarding or previously chose Something else. It asks the user to choose one numbered role, including Other. No placeholders.

First numbered job-role option on the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Design means a design-related professional role. It is selected initially only when it matches the end user's existing saved occupation. Appears alongside Engineering, Product, Research, and Other. Short label. No placeholders.

Second numbered job-role option on the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Engineering means a software or other engineering-related professional role. Appears alongside Design, Product, Research, and Other. Short label. No placeholders.

Short label for the final numbered job-role option on the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. End users select Other when none of the preceding role options fit. Selecting it does not reveal a text field. No placeholders or markup.

Third numbered job-role option on the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Product means product management or product development as a professional role. Appears alongside Design, Engineering, Research, and Other. Short label. No placeholders.

Fourth numbered job-role option on the role-confirmation card in the ChatGPT Work personalization onboarding conversation. Research means a professional research role. Appears alongside Design, Engineering, Product, and Other. Short label. No placeholders.

messages.text: Look through my chats, Library files, and any connected apps for a new and real writing task you could help with. Briefly explain what you found, why you chose it, and which examples of my own writing you’ll use. Then produce a useful draft closely matching my style. Point out two specific choices you made to match my style. If you can’t find a clear task or enough examples, ask me for a draft, template, or writing sample instead of inventing one. Show the draft here; do not send, post, or modify anything.
messages.description: Request sent to ChatGPT when a user selects Show me in writing-style setup. Ask it to use available chats, Library files, and connected apps to find a new, real writing task, explain its choice and the user's own writing examples, produce a useful draft closely matching their writing style, and explain two style choices. If context is insufficient, ask for a draft, template, or sample instead of inventing one. The draft must stay in chat without sending, posting, or modifying anything. Library is the product's file library. Use natural first-person request wording. Plain text with no placeholders.
